evidence_plan.requirement: previously reported results on speculation detection and scope resolution

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific previously reported results, comparisons of models, and metrics of improvement in speculation detection and scope resolution tasks.

claims.text: Previous work on speculation detection and scope resolution reported substantial improvements, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa in speculation detection and scope resolution tasks, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets.
The application of transformer-based architectures has led to state-of-the-art results in negation scope resolution on multiple datasets.
